data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German 'Fariz' meaning 'man of Rudolph' or 'ferd' meaning 'journey'. In Old English, 'ric' meaning 'ruler' or 'power'. The name Ferrick could represent a powerful, fiery man who embarks on a journey or rules with strength and determination. The name Ferrick carries the meaning “Fiery ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ferrick usually hope their child will grow to embody fiery ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
